messages:
Samira Patel: Heads-up — Acme POC incoming. They said they need a signed DPA + SCCs before we start ingesting live customer data, and they want evidence of deletion for any DSARs during the POC. Also asked for a completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire. Can we assemble answers and a timeline? POC kickoff earliest Mon. cc @Maria Gonzalez
Alex Kim: I can take the SIG/CAIQ infra + auth sections. Quick notes: hosted API default log retention 30d, KV cache ephemeral per session unless explicitly enabled, Dedicated/Private options available if they require no hosted retention. Will draft concise answers and a short evidence pack.
Alex Kim: Snippet I'll paste into SIG 'data retention' answers:
```json
{
  "default_log_retention_days": 30,
  "poc_exceptions": "can be reduced to 0 on customer request for POC",
  "deletion_workflow": "deletion executed within 24h of verified request; audit stamp produced"
}
```
Maria Gonzalez: We can send our standard DPA + 2021 SCCs addendum. FYI Acme is asking for a 'delete all derivatives' clause — legal prefers wording: 'we will delete customer data and customer-provided outputs derived from that data on request.' Need Alex to confirm how we treat embeddings/derived artifacts.
Jonathan Park: Security side: we can export a CAIQ + evidence bundle (network diagrams, MFA screenshots, control owners). For DSARs during POC: our flow issues a deletion token and we provide an audit trail (who requested, what was deleted, time). We can provide a hash-based proof-of-deletion entry in the audit. Timeline: CAIQ + evidence package ~48h, DPA countersign depends on their legal (estimate 3–5 business days).
SecBot: Automated: control-docs export job queued (ticket KR-458). Estimated ready in 48h.
Emily Chen: Pricing/narrow scope: suggest offering 2-week POC credits + clause: 'data used only for scope of POC; data auto-deleted at POC end unless customer requests extension.' Also recommend a one-page POC success criteria doc so Acme doesn't expand scope mid-run.
Samira Patel: Next steps: Alex to update SIG answers and confirm whether embeddings are treated as persisted customer data for the hosted POC. Maria to send DPA + SCC template to Acme legal. Jonathan to assemble CAIQ + deletion proof runbook. Emily and I will draft POC terms (scope, creds, auto-delete). Any blockers?
Alex Kim: Confirming: embeddings are ephemeral for hosted by default (cache only) and not persisted to long-term stores unless customer opts in or we enable debugging. In Dedicated/Private modes embeddings may be persisted to customer-owned storage. For Acme hosted POC we will set `persist_embeddings=false`. I'll update the SIG answers and paste final text here by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: I'll prepare the DPA + 2021 SCC PDF and email Acme legal. If they push significant redlines (e.g., new 'derivatives' obligations beyond our template), escalate to me and legal will track. :white_check_mark:
Samira Patel: Great — I'll reply to Acme with the timeline and ask them to upload the SIG file here. Ping me if anything needs immediate attention.
